team.name: Lidia González
team.bio: Over 18 years of experience in cuts and coloring. Specialist in balayage and French coloring techniques. Trained in São Paulo and Buenos Aires.

team.name: Claudia Muñoz
team.bio: Technician in keratin, hair botox and reconstructive treatments. Seeks total client satisfaction with every service.

team.name: María Ferreira
team.bio: Specialist in event and wedding hairstyles. Creates unique looks that enhance each client's natural beauty.

team.name: Ana Rodríguez

testimonials.name: María Fernández
testimonials.quote: I've been going to Magnolia for 2 years. The best balayage I've ever had. The attention is impeccable, they listen to me and it always turns out great.

testimonials.name: Carmen López
testimonials.quote: I loved the keratin treatment. My hair was super smooth and lasted over 3 months. The quality-price ratio is excellent.

testimonials.name: Ana Martínez
testimonials.quote: The only salon where I feel like they really listen. The environment is beautiful, very calm, and the prices are very fair.

testimonials.name: Claudia Rodríguez
testimonials.quote: I went for my wedding and they did an spectacular hairstyle. All the guests asked where I had my hair done. 100% recommended!

testimonials.name: Laura Benítez
testimonials.quote: The highlights turned out incredible. Lidia is an artist. The salon is super clean and they make you feel at home.

testimonials.name: Sofía Meza
testimonials.quote: I bought a gift card for my mom and she loved it. The bridal service is on another level. Totally recommended.

testimonials.name: Patricia Ruiz
testimonials.quote: I did the hair botox after a terrible summer with my hair. Wow result. It was super shiny and manageable.

testimonials.name: Gabriela Sanabria
testimonials.quote: I went for a trim and they convinced me to try the nutrition treatment. My hair was super soft.

testimonials.name: Daniela Castillo
testimonials.quote: I have very difficult hair and they always make me feel confident they'll know what to do. The best hands in Asunción.

testimonials.name: Valentina Acevedo
testimonials.quote: The Balayage they did is exactly what I wanted. Nobody notices it's done. It looks like natural sun color.

testimonials.name: Isabel Morales
testimonials.quote: First time here and I already have my next appointment booked. The keratin lasted 4 months perfectly. Amazing.

testimonials.name: Carolina Estigarribia
testimonials.quote: I've been taking my daughter since she was 8. They do kids cuts with a lot of patience. She always leaves happy.

faqs.q: ¿Necesito turno o puedo ir sin cita?
faqs.a: Recomendamos reservar con anticipación, especialmente para tratamientos y eventos. Podés pedir tu turno por WhatsApp. Sin embargo, si tenemos disponibilidad, te atendemos sin cita.

Nuestros cortes van desde Gs. 50.000 hasta Gs. 90.000. Los tratamientos de coloración arrancan en Gs. 250.000. Keratina y peinados para eventos tienen precios según complejidad. Consultanos por WhatsApp para un presupuesto exacto.
Sí, trabajamos exclusivamente con marcas internacionales premium como Wella, Schwarzkopf y Alfaparf. Cuidamos tu cabello usando productos profesionales en cada servicio.
Sí! Contamos con servicio completo de novias: peinado, maquillaje y prueba previa. Reservá con al menos 2 semanas de anticipación para garantizar disponibilidad.
Estamos en zona céntrica de Asunción con fácil acceso. Hay estacionamiento público en las cercanías y algunos restaurantes vecinos que permiten uso de sus cocheras.
